blocks.title: Integration testing
blocks.text: Unit testing ke baad integration testing hisson ya modules ke darmiyan taamul jaanchti hai. Unit testing akeli units dekhti hai, jabke integration testing yaqeeni banati hai ke units milne par theek mil kar kaam karein.

Yeh interface ki ghaltiyan, modules ke darmiyan data ka bahao aur integration ke doosre masail jaanchti hai, aur woh khamiyan pakarti hai jo unit testing nahi dikha sakti, jaise modules ke rabte ya data sambhalne mein be-mel.

blocks.prompt: Do units jo apne unit tests paas karti hain mil kar phir bhi kyun nakaam ho sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: Har ek akele chal sakti hai magar jurne ke tareeqe par ikhtilaf ho sakta hai, maslan ek aise format mein data bheje jo doosri ko tawaqqo nahi; integration testing aise interface aur data ke bahao ke masail pakarti hai.

items: Integration testing: unit testing ke baad; units ka mel; modules ke darmiyan interfaces aur data ka bahao jaanchti hai.
